about.builtOnMetaModelsSam: Built on Meta models: SAM 3.1 finds the shelves, Muse Spark reads lists and labels the shelves, Muse Wonder reads receipt photos, Muse Voice Transcribe takes dictation, and Muse Image drew the characters that cheer each grab.

login.aryaKeepsYourListKnows: Arya keeps your list, knows what’s running low, and tells you what’s up at your store before you go.
login.every7DaysLastBought: Every ~7 days, last bought 10 days ago
login.traderJoeSShoppersSay: Trader Joe’s: shoppers say out today
login.fromYourReceiptsNoTyping: From your receipts. No typing it all in.
login.questTurnsYourListInto: Quest turns your list into a treasure hunt through the store.
login.aryaLearnsWhatYourHousehold: Arya learns what your household buys from its receipts and keeps your lists. It tells you what is running low and why, what is out or cheaper at your store, and what to use soon.
login.whenYouWantItFun: When you want it fun, Quest turns the list into a hunt through the real store: you walk it in photos from one shopper’s walkthrough video, with a 3D model of the aisle one tap away. The receipt at checkout settles the score.
login.theDemoOpensAFictional: The demo opens a fictional household, no account needed. Your hunts, list changes and chats last only for this visit. The camera and microphone call the Meta API live.
login.builtOnMetaModelsEntry: Built on Meta models. Entry in the Meta AI Developer Hackathon.

mapper.theMoreOfYourStore: The more of your store Arya knows, the more it helps you: real shelf photos in your hunt, the exact aisle for each item, and fewer “can't find it” moments. Teach it the aisles you use, a little at a time. Other shoppers fill in the rest.
mapper.pickAStoreFromMy: Pick a store from My Stores first.
mapper.teachTheAislesYouUse: Teach the aisles you use. You never need all of them.
mapper.noAislesHereYetWalk: No aisles here yet. Walk the store and Arya builds the map from what it sees.
mapper.justWalkTheAislesYou: Just walk the aisles you shop, phone up. Arya reads the shelves, names each section, and builds the map. Afterwards you check what it found — that's all.
mapper.aryaKnowsEveryAisleYou: Arya knows every aisle you picked. Your hunts here use real shelf photos now.
mapper.weBlurEveryPersonBefore: We blur every person before we save a photo. We keep pictures of products only.

mode.playTheHuntCharactersPoints: Play the hunt: characters, points and badges. Arya helps you find each item.
mode.sameHelpFromAryaNo: Same help from Arya, no game: show me the aisle, find it with the camera, report a problem. No characters, points or badges.
mode.bothEndTheSameWay: Both end the same way: add your receipt and share your haul. Either one can pause, and trips switch from the rail while you play.

muse.useAryaFromAnAi: Use Arya from an AI assistant you already talk to. It can add to your list, tell you what is running low and file receipts it reads. It works with any assistant that supports MCP connectors. Make a link code, then paste it into your assistant. The code is shown once; making a new one replaces it.
muse.copyItNowItIs: Copy it now — it is not shown again. Paste it into your assistant's connector settings.
muse.pasteItIntoYourAssistant: Paste it into your assistant so it knows how to use Arya.
